contributions.summary: Year carbon is living wood plus products, and slope area is the projected area divided by the cosine.
A dynamic program picks from five rates under a 50 percent cap on the hundred-year sum.

dependency_graph.handoff: The living store and the product store are what the dynamic program maximizes, under a 50 percent cap on the sum of annual rates.

assumptions.summary: Planted forests cannot be used for carbon sequestration, so only primary forests are kept.
Ages are uniform and identical across forests, and unexpected death is negligibly low.
Only age matters at the cut, and one maturity threshold covers every species.
A larger slope angle means a greater sequestration capacity, so area is divided by the cosine.
The uniform age is later called not robust, because a previous manager harvested by preference.
